input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and sits in walk-away territory as an exclusive foreign venue. It also contradicts Section 28.2, which already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. We therefore conform 28.1 to New York law and New York County courts, the preferred position, which resolves the internal inconsistency. Section 28.3's pre-suit executive escalation is acceptable process and is not flagged.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Singapore law and exclusive Singapore venue with New York law and New York County courts, which is our accepted position and also removes the contradiction with Section 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would also work if needed.
proposal.summary: Change governing law and venue from Singapore to New York, aligning with Section 28.2.
